commit.message:
fix(oss): harden deployment telemetry and fix self-host enablement (#4513)

* fix(oss): harden deployment telemetry and fix self-host enablement

Wrap the full heartbeat path in try/catch so Redis failures cannot reject
startup, cover reportOssDeploymentHeartbeat with unit tests, and force
NODE_ENV=production plus LAT_IMAGE_TAG into docker-stack app services so
copied .env.example values do not silently disable OSS telemetry.

Co-authored-by: Gerard <gerard@latitude.so>

* feat(oss): bundle PostHog project key for deployment heartbeats

Self-hosted production installs can now send oss_deployment_heartbeat
events without extra env configuration.

Co-authored-by: Gerard <gerard@latitude.so>

* fix(oss): stop forcing NODE_ENV in docker-stack

Leave NODE_ENV to .env.production; keep LAT_IMAGE_TAG so heartbeats
still report the compose image tag.

Co-authored-by: Gerard <gerard@latitude.so>

---------

Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>
